jobs.title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
jobs.description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future. Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform. We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems. We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role. Responsibilities Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation. Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance. Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers. Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation. Requirements Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch. Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers. Work with physicists validating the datasets & labels. Work with our computational scientists and control engineers, who build models and controllers on these datasets, and with customers to understand and integrate their data. Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB. jobs.title: Founding Engineer (gn) – Hardware & Bioengineering, Munich
jobs.description: About Cellsor Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that. We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring. We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering). About the role As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months. What you will do: Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation Test and iterate with our Boston biology team Contribute to grant applications What you need to succeed Must-have: MSc or PhD in mechanical, biomedical or bioengineering, or a related field Built a lab or medical device from concept to working prototype CAD, rapid prototyping, and electronics integration Comfortable with uncertainty: you make progress without a defined path and decide what to build next Hands-on and self-directed – you'd rather test an idea on the bench than discuss it for a week Fluent English; German a plus Nice-to-have: Cell culture, perfusion or microfluidics Gas handling or air sampling S

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human. Year one, in order First, ship. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself. Along the way, make what you build safe to change. jobs.title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
jobs.description: The Challenge We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next. A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow. Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: De uitdaging Onze klant ontwikkelt high-tech embedded systemen die extreem betrouwbaar, veilig en performant moeten zijn. Je werkt in een omgeving waar innovatie de standaard is en waar jouw code direct invloed heeft op hardware, sensoren, controllers en real-time verwerking. We zoeken engineers die met plezier de diepte ingaan: van low-level drivers tot robust architecture en van integratie tot performance-optimalisatie. Wat ga je doen? Als Embedded Software Engineer werk je via GradeMatch binnen een multidisciplinair engineeringteam dat software, elektronica en systeemarchitectuur combineert. Je ontwikkelt embedded software in C en C++, analyseert hardware-interactie, werkt met RTOS-omgevingen en draagt bij aan nieuwe en bestaande modules. Je krijgt te maken met complexe systemen, nieuwe productfeatures, protocollen, edge computing, testscenario’s en integratie met high-end apparatuur. Hoe je impact maakt Je implementeert embedded softwaremodules in C en C++ volgens hoge kwaliteitseisen en werkt aan drivers, interfaces, communicatiestromen en configuratiecomponenten. Je stelt duidelijke requirements op en denkt actief mee over designkeuzes, terwijl je samen met andere engineers high-level en low-level architectuurvoorstellen uitwerkt. Daarnaast test en review je code op betrouwbaarheid, performance en stabiliteit en werk je nauw samen met hardware engineers om een correcte integratie te waarborgen. Je begeleidt de live-gang, validatie en nazorg binnen de embedded omgeving en documenteert code, flows, architectuur en testresultaten zorgvuldig. Wat je van ons krijgt Salaris: €3.500 - €6.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring Uitdagende projecten bij een high-tech klant via GradeMatch Opleidingen, begeleiding en technische sparringpartners Hybride werken mogelijk Mogelijkheden tot specialisatie (RTOS, C++, architectuur, security, Linux internals) Wat het jou oplevert Werken aan cutting-edge embedded technologie binnen een high-tech organisatie. In deze rol werk je aan het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en verbeteren van bedrijfskritische applicaties die essentieel zijn voor de dagelijkse operatie. Je draagt bij aan stabiele, veilige en toekomstbestendige systemen en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines. Wat ga je doen? Als Developer versterk je het IT-team en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en optimaliseren van applicaties binnen de IT-omgeving. Je analyseert technische vraagstukken, vertaalt deze naar praktische oplossingen en implementeert nieuwe applicaties, updates en verbeteringen. Daarnaast los je complexe technische storingen op en draag je bij aan procesverbeteringen. Je stelt technische documentatie op en ondersteunt bij de implementatie van nieuwe systemen. Hoe je impact maakt Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt bedrijfskritische applicaties en zorgt ervoor dat deze efficiënt, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn. Je test, reviewt en optimaliseert code en documenteert processen zodat het team goed kan samenwerken. Je ondersteunt bij live-gang, nazorg en continue verbetering van systemen. Door actief mee te denken over innovatieve oplossingen help je de IT-omgeving verder te professionaliseren. jobs.title: Embedded Software Designer
jobs.description: De uitdaging Wij zoeken per direct een Embedded Software Designer voor ons zusterbedrijf Veynex in de regio Limburg / Brabant. Haal jij voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van slimme technische oplossingen en complexe softwarevraagstukken? Dan past deze rol bij je. Als Embedded Software Designer werk je binnen multidisciplinaire ontwikkelomgevingen aan innovatieve projecten met hoge kwaliteitsnormen. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces: van requirements en architectuur tot implementatie en testing. Je werkt samen met ervaren engineers en krijgt volop ruimte om jouw technische kennis verder uit te bouwen. Wat ga je doen? Als Embedded Software Designer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren van embedded softwareoplossingen. Je stelt technische architecturen op, ontwikkelt software in C en/of C++, en test de werking van systemen. Daarnaast integreer je verschillende softwaremodules en zorg je voor duidelijke documentatie. Je werkt aan projecten binnen Embedded Linux, RTOS of OS-less omgevingen en schakelt regelmatig met collega’s uit andere disciplines. Hoe je impact maakt Je bent een belangrijke schakel binnen het ontwikkelteam en zorgt ervoor dat softwareoplossingen betrouwbaar, efficiënt en toekomstbestendig zijn. Door jouw inzet verlopen projecten soepel en worden technische uitdagingen succesvol opgelost. Je draagt bij aan innovatieve producten en de groei van het team. Wat je van ons krijgt Salaris: €3.750 - €5.500 bruto p/m, afhankelijk van ervaring Goede begeleiding en een duidelijk inwerktraject Werken in een professioneel en technisch sterk team Hybride werken met goede thuiswerkfaciliteiten Pensioenregeling en goede verzekeringen Mobiliteitsregeling: NS Businesscard, reiskostenvergoeding of auto van de zaak Veel ruimte voor opleiding en persoonlijke ontwikkeling Wat het jou oplevert Veel afwisseling in uitdagende technische projecten Werken met moderne technologieën en systemen Snel groeien in kennis en verantwoordelijkhe

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: De uitdaging Wij zoeken per direct een Software Test Engineer voor ons zusterbedrijf Veynex in de regio Limburg / Brabant. Haal jij voldoening uit het waarborgen van softwarekwaliteit en het continu verbeteren van testprocessen? Dan past deze rol bij je. Als Software Test Engineer werk je samen met product owners, domeinexperts en ontwikkelteams aan het opstellen van heldere en effectieve testplannen. Je zorgt ervoor dat software op alle niveaus van de stack grondig wordt getest en zet actief in op testautomatisering. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige testproces en draagt bij aan het verbeteren van softwarekwaliteit binnen multidisciplinaire ontwikkelomgevingen. Wat ga je doen? Als Software Test Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, uitvoeren en verbeteren van testprocessen. Je stelt testplannen op, scherpt requirements aan waar nodig en zorgt ervoor dat tests efficiënt worden uitgevoerd. Je gebruikt scripts en geautomatiseerde testtools om software te testen, valideert testresultaten en rapporteert bevindingen aan stakeholders. Daarnaast ontwikkel je verificatieplannen, kwaliteitsborgingsprocedures en teststrategieën. Door continu te zoeken naar verbeteringen in processen en automatisering help je het team om softwarekwaliteit sprint na sprint te verhogen. Hoe je impact maakt Je bent een cruciale schakel in het leveren van betrouwbare en hoogwaardige software. Door jouw nauwkeurigheid worden fouten vroegtijdig opgespoord en opgelost, waardoor producten robuuster, gebruiksvriendelijker en toekomstbestendiger worden. Je draagt direct bij aan de kwaliteit van softwareproducten én aan de verdere professionalisering van het ontwikkelproces. Wat je van ons krijgt Salaris: €2.350 – €4.500 bruto p/m, afhankelijk van ervaring en fit met de functie Flexibele werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur Goede pensioenregeling Verzekeringen bij arbeidsongeschiktheid Hybride werken met goede thuiswerkfaciliteiten Mobiliteitsregeling: NS Businesscard, reiskostenvergoeding of auto

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer PLC & Industry
jobs.description: De uitdaging Complexe machines vragen om software die vanaf het eerste ontwerp klopt. PLC-besturing, motion, robotica, hardware en mechanica moeten naadloos samenwerken. En bij machines die nog niet eerder zijn gebouwd, ligt de oplossing niet vooraf klaar. Als Lead Software Engineer PLC & Industrial Automation neem jij de technische leiding over de softwareontwikkeling binnen complexe hightech machinebouw. Je vertaalt functionele eisen en klantwensen naar een robuuste besturingsoplossing en bewaakt de technische keuzes van ontwerp en architectuur tot commissioning en ingebruikname. Wat ga je doen? Je bent technisch verantwoordelijk voor de software binnen multidisciplinaire machinebouwprojecten. Je vertaalt klantwensen en systeemeisen naar een softwarearchitectuur en bepaalt hoe de besturing wordt opgebouwd: Ontwerpen van softwarearchitectuur voor complexe machines Ontwikkelen van PLC-software en oplossingen voor motion en robotica Vertalen van requirements naar technische oplossingen Inhoudelijk aansturen en begeleiden van software engineers Afstemmen met system, mechanical en electrical engineering Bewaken van technische keuzes, kwaliteit en voortgang Testen, debuggen en commissionen van machines Technische afstemming met klanten tijdens het project Hoe je impact maakt Jouw keuzes bepalen hoe een machine wordt aangestuurd en hoe betrouwbaar deze uiteindelijk presteert. Je kijkt verder dan alleen de PLC-code en overziet de samenhang tussen software, motion, robotica, hardware en mechanica. Je bent technisch aanspreekpunt voor engineers en klanten, neemt andere software engineers mee in technische keuzes en zorgt dat oplossingen niet alleen werken, maar ook robuust, onderhoudbaar en herbruikbaar zijn. Daarmee heb je direct invloed op zowel de machine als de manier waarop software binnen toekomstige projecten wordt ontwikkeld. Wat je van ons krijgt Salaris van €4.000 – €7.500 bruto per maand 27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen Jaarlijkse winstuitkering Goede pensioenrege

We are driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow, while staying friendly, enthusiastic, and committed to helping each other succeed. Working at AIHR means taking real responsibility, improving how we operate, and getting the freedom to develop in new areas and shape your role as the company grows. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. jobs.description: Analyseren, (functioneel) testen, debuggen… Waar houd jij je als test engineer bij ons eigenlijk niet mee bezig!? Als test engineer is iedere werkdag anders. De complexe producten die wij maken voor onze klanten, maken gebruik van proces- en functionele testers. Uitval hiervan wordt geanalyseerd en testers worden gedebugged. Dit wordt in samenwerking met ons Test Development team gedaan, die onze testers hebben ontwikkeld, gebouwd én vrijgegeven. Het grootste gedeelte van je werkdag ben je bezig met praktische en analytische werkzaamheden. Een greep uit je werkzaamheden als test engineer: Testen van prototypes: in een losse testopstelling op je werkbank meten. Debuggen/functioneel testen in Labview: bijvoorbeeld na uitval op de functionele tester. Sustainable analyseren: uitzoeken wat er is gebeurd, waarom is dit gebeurd en hoe we dit in de toekomst kunnen voorkomen. Reparatie van uitgevallen producten; uitval na o.a. AOI, Flying probe of functionele testers of retouren vanuit de klant. Interne overleggen: bijvoorbeeld met je collega’s van de afdeling Quality, Engineering etc. Technisch challengen : niet alleen bij Benchmark collega’s, maar soms ook bij de klant. Jij zorgt in alles wat je doet voor de juiste analyses en verwerking hiervan. Hierdoor worden afwijkingen gefilterd en gesignaleerd, worden root-causes vastgesteld en opgelost en blijft het productieproces continu verbeteren. Wat biedt Benchmark? jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Ben jij een Senior Quality Engineer die verder kijkt dan het oplossen van afwijkingen? Iemand die kwaliteit ziet als een stuurinstrument en het voortouw neemt in structurele verbetering? Dan bieden wij jou een rol waarin je écht het verschil maakt. Als Senior Quality Engineer ben je een sleutelspeler in het naar een hoger volwassenheidsniveau brengen van onze kwaliteitsperformance. Je acteert proactief, signaleert risico’s vóórdat ze problemen worden en stuurt op duurzame oplossingen. Je bent geen volger van processen, maar mede‑vormgever van hoe kwaliteit wordt geborgd, verbeterd en beleefd wordt bij ons. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het inhoudelijk en methodisch leiden van verbetertrajecten, waaronder het aanjagen en begeleiden van het Quality Improvement Team (QIT‑proces). Je fungeert daarbij als coach, challenger en inhoudelijk geweten. Wat ga je, onder andere, doen? Proactief analyseren van kwaliteitsafwijkingen, trends en risico’s om structurele, systeemgedreven oorzaken bloot te leggen. Leiden van root cause analyses en borgen van effectieve, duurzame CAPA’s. Initiëren, ontwikkelen en borgen van kwaliteitsstandaarden, procedures en werkinstructies. Voorbereiden, uitvoeren en doelgericht benutten van interne en externe audits. Analyseren en vertalen van kwaliteits‑KPI’s naar concrete verbeteracties en besluitvorming. Regie voeren op kwaliteit binnen NPI‑projecten, inclusief kritische beoordeling van deliverables en klantspecificaties. Waar maak jij het verschil? Je werkt intensief samen met productie, engineering, supply chain en klanten, maar neemt vooral ook inhoudelijk leiderschap. Je stelt de juiste vragen, doorbreekt reactieve patronen en helpt de organisatie om kwaliteit voorspelbaar, robuust en toekomstbestendig in te richten. Binnen het team krijg je ruimte om verbeterinitiatieven te initiëren, anderen daarin mee te nemen en samen te bepalen waar jouw expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt. Kortom: een rol voor een professional die eigenaarschap

This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As a Medior C++ Engineer, you will take ownership of software components within our hardware-integrated systems. You will design, implement, and improve robust C++ software that interacts with multiple subsystems, and real-time environments. jobs.title: IAM Platform Engineer - PKI & Cloud Native
jobs.description: Wil jij bouwen aan de veilige basis van een modern identity platform? Binnen het IAM Platform team van CBS zoeken we een engineer die zich richt op PKI, certificaten, machine identities en cloud-native security binnen een open en toekomstbestendig platformlandschap. Bouw jij hier aan mee? Waar jij het verschil maakt In deze rol werk je aan de technische fundamenten onder veilige toegang en betrouwbare machine-to-machine communicatie. Je ontwerpt en bouwt een moderne, geautomatiseerde PKI-dienst die de huidige Microsoft-gebaseerde root en intermediate CA vervangt. Daarbij combineer je een sterke security-achtergrond met een platformengineering-mindset, waarin GitOps, Infrastructure as Code en self-service voor DevOps- en applicatieteams centraal staan. Je werkt op het snijvlak van identity, security en platformengineering. Daarbij: ontwerp en implementeer je een nieuwe PKI-architectuur met root- en intermediate CA’s op basis van open standaarden, bij voorkeur met open source technologie; migreer je de bestaande Microsoft-PKI gefaseerd naar de nieuwe oplossing, met minimale impact op productieomgevingen, op basis van Cloud-native, Open-source software; richt je geautomatiseerd certificaat lifecycle management in voor issuance, renewal, revocation en rotatie, zodat infrastructuur en applicaties zichzelf van certificaten kunnen voorzien; bouw je PKI als platformdienst met GitOps-workflows, Infrastructure as Code en API-gedreven of self-service provisioning via platforms en CI/CD; integreer je PKI met Kubernetes en containerplatformen, hybride en cloudomgevingen, on-premises workloads en de IAM- en Keycloak-infrastructuur, waaronder TLS-certificaten, mTLS-clients, truststores en certificaatgebaseerde authenticatie; leg je architectuurkeuzes, standaarden, rollen en verantwoordelijkheden vast en borg je security, compliance en continuïteit, waaronder ISO 27001 en relevante overheidsrichtlijnen. Je toekomstige collega's Je wordt onderdeel van het IAM Platform team van CBS.

jobs.description: About FoodLabs FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. About The General Data Corporation General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. Why this is a unique opportunity AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. jobs.description: Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Ingénieur mécanique de vol et simulation numérique d'un HAPS (F/H) au sein de la Division Space&Sky sur le site d'Ayguesvives (31450). Contexte : Dans le cadre du développement de solution type HAPS (High Altitude Pseudo Satellite) ballon, Hemeria souhaite développer un outils de dimensionnement pour le pilotage de trajectoire de son ballon manœuvrant. BALMAN est un ballon capable de montée et descendre en altitude. Les vents changeant de direction suivant le profil en Z il est possible de contrôler la trajectoire du ballon. Missions du stage : Etude Biblio courte du projet LOON de Google Post traitement de données météo (.json) en python pour créer des cartes de vent (python, traitement de données, météo) Développer un modèle de physique du vol qui intègre la routine de pilotage en trajectoire Effectuer des simulations pour faire du stationnaire et évaluer les performances de vol (Qualité de Vol) de l’aérostat Profil : Idéalement de formation aéronautique avec une expérience en Python (Pandas n’est pas un animal pour vous) vous souhaitez poursuivre votre carrière dans le monde de la simulation numérique et/ou du contrôle commande (SCAO…). Vous n’avez pas peur des équations de physique de vol (Dynamique du Vol, physique des gaz/loi des gaz parfait et Archimède). Vous vous intéressez au système innovant (HAPS) Mots clés : #Python #Dynamique de Vol #physique de Vol #newspace #Balman Si vous êtes êtes intéressé(e) par les systèmes innovants et que vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dynamique, postulez dès maintenant. jobs.title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
jobs.description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up. Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around. We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one. Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it. About the Role As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath. Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows. You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together.

Backed by private equity investor Volpi Capital, we operate across the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, Poland and the United States. Our customers range from Kommunen, Länder and federal authorities to Stadtwerke, utilities and telecom infrastructure companies. Our culture is driven by curiosity and innovation, guided by impact and purpose, and built on collaboration, trust, transparency and accountability. We believe diverse perspectives drive innovation, and we are committed to building a team that reflects different backgrounds, identities and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone. Job Summary Germany is one of Cyclomedia's most important markets and a key pillar of our growth strategy. As Head / Senior Director of Sales, Central Europe, you will lead the next phase of our growth across DACH and Poland as a hands-on sales leader who owns the pipeline, the team and the plan. You will build on a strong foundation: an established sales team and a base of strong reference customers. Your mandate is to take this to the next level by building a predictable, scalable sales engine with full visibility across pipeline, accounts and forecast. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY. jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. jobs.description: About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. jobs.title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
jobs.description: Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading. About the Role We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers

jobs.title: Talent Director
jobs.description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance. The Role The Talent Director owns how OLIX finds, wins and hires the people who will build it. You will take a talent function built for around 200 people and make it one that carries us confidently to 1,000, across London, Bristol, Austin, San Francisco and Toronto, without lowering the bar on a single hire. This is a hands on leadership role. You will personally lead our most senior and executive searches, and close people who are not looking. Many of the people we need exist in pools of a few dozen worldwide: III-V device engineers, advanced packaging architects, optical interconnect specialists, AI software engineers, silicon leaders who have taken a chip to production. Hiring them is a precision problem, not a volume one. You will build a team of recruiters as sharp as the engineers they hire, and set an AI strategy for recruiting that changes how we decide, not just how fast we work. The best argument wins here, and we expect you to make it, welcome challenges to it, and change your mind when the evidence says so. Du gibst deinem Team dabei die technische Richtung. Deine Urteilskraft kommt aus dem Betrieb, also aus echten Störungen und Kundenproblemen. Daraus entscheidest du im Team, bringst Vorhaben spürbar voran und lässt deine Kolleg*innen fachlich mitwachsen. Personalverantwortung hast du nicht, dafür umso mehr fachlichen Einfluss. Du weißt, wie Kubernetes auf eigener Hardware läuft und was passiert, wenn es das nicht tut. jobs.description: Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good. Why This Role Exists Grove's owned brands — Grove Co., Rooted Beauty, Grab Green, and 8Greens — are the highest-margin, highest-control part of our assortment and the clearest expression of our human health point of view. They are also where the hardest problems live: contract manufacturers who need managing, packaging that has to survive a supply chain, claims that have to hold up to a third-party lab, and launch dates that are set by retail partners and don't move. This role owns those brands end to end — the margin math, the vendor relationships, the product development calendar, the claims and compliance work that gates our sales channels, and the quality problems that surface after launch. It is a small-team, wide-aperture job: you are the single point of accountability for a domain that touches inventory planning, marketing, creative, quality, finance, and our fulfillment centers, and you do the work yourself rather than routing it to a team. What You'll Own Owned brand product development and packaging Own the development calendar for Grove Co., Rooted Beauty, Grab Green, and 8Greens — new items, seasonal and limited-edition programs, line extensions, and format changes from brief through first production run. Own packaging decisions and their consequences: substrate and format selection, die lines, master case specification, compatibility of formula to package, and cost per unit. Build and maintain the specification and briefing standards these programs run on, so a new item moves through development the same way every time rather than being reinvented per launch. jobs.description: Senior AI/ML Engineer, remote in Canada: own the AI that assesses patients for US healthcare providers and gets them to the right mental health care faster. About Limbic Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere. Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians. Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomized, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill. The Role As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will take ownership of the AI in our clinical assessment product for US healthcare organizations. A patient describes what they are struggling with in a conversation with our AI, which gathers their history, administers standard clinical questionnaires such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, detects risk and recommends a treatment program for the organization’s clinicians to review. Every organization configures it for its own services, so the AI has to be safe and accurate across many clinical setups, not just one. The approach is proven at scale in the NHS, where it increased referrals from minority groups by 29%, as published in Nature Medicine. You will work in North American hours alongside product, engineering and clinical colleagues, in close collaboration with our ML team in London. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across Limbic. What You’ll Do Own

jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine, Oncology and Rare Disease is not your typical CRO. We are now recruiting Clinical Research Associates (different seniority levels) to join our team in Germany. CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. You will focus on an average of one to two studies setting you up to be a protocol expert. You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties. You have an impeccable eye for detail. You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them. You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work. You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies. How we will keep you busy and support your growth: You will monitor and own the progress of clinical studies at investigative sites and ensure that clinical studies are conducted, recorded, and reported per protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP, and all applicable regulations and standards. jobs.title: Opticien (contrat freelance)
jobs.description: Qui est Alan ? En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé . L'optique est au cœur de la promesse d’Alan "La santé ne peut pas attendre". Avec l 'Alan Shop , nos membres achètent lunettes et lentilles de contact depuis l'application ; avec notre réseau d'opticiens partenaires , ils sont mieux remboursés en magasin ; et nos équipes Fraude veillent à ce que chaque euro remboursé le soit à bon escient. Nous avons prouvé qu'une assurance santé pouvait vendre de l'optique en ligne. Nous voulons maintenant passer à l'échelle, avec un·e opticien·ne supplémentaire dans l'équipe. Ce que nous recherchons Ce opticien·ne diplômé·e, à l'aise avec le conseil à distance et motivé·e pour rejoindre l'équipe d'opticiens prenant en charge les différentes missions autours de l'optique d'Alan Shop. Les missions : Chat optique. Répondre à nos membres sur l'application (choix de monture, lecture d'ordonnance, verres, lentilles, questions d'optique au sens large), avec le ton Alan : clair, bienveillant, personnalisé. Validation des commandes de lentilles de contact. Contrôler les ordonnances que notre outil automatique ne peut pas valider, et signaler les suspicions de fraude (dates modifiées, documents falsifiés) à notre équipe dédiée. « Mon Opticien au Travail ». Animer des journées de conseil et de vente sur site chez nos entreprises clientes, sur la France entière et en priorité en Île-de-France : accueil des salariés, conseil visagiste, prise de mesures, aide au choix de la monture. Amélioration continue. Partager vos retours terrain pour faire évoluer le service, et potentiellement être investi de potentielles missions additionnelles comme : contribuer à la montée en puissance de Mo, notre compagnon santé IA, sur les questions d'optique simples étoffer le catalogue de montures de l’Alan Sho

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require.  Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind. Your Responsibilities Y

Kantor ini bertugas untuk memberikan pelayanan terkait perpajakan kepada wajib pajak yang berada di wilayahnya. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama biasanya melayani wajib pajak yang memiliki jenis usaha atau perorangan dengan volume transaksi yang lebih kecil dibandingkan dengan kantor pajak yang lebih besar seperti Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Besar. Penerimaan Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama. Tugas utama Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama adalah mengumpulkan, mengelola, dan memberikan informasi serta panduan kepada wajib pajak mengenai peraturan perpajakan, pelaporan pajak, serta pembayaran pajak. Mereka juga melakukan pemeriksaan pajak untuk memastikan kepatuhan wajib pajak terhadap aturan perpajakan. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama ini biasanya tersebar di berbagai wilayah di seluruh Indonesia untuk memudahkan wajib pajak dalam mengakses layanan perpajakan tanpa harus pergi ke kantor pajak yang lebih besar. Tujuannya adalah untuk meningkatkan kepatuhan perpajakan dan memfasilitasi wajib pajak dalam memenuhi kewajibannya terkait pajak. Lowongan Kerja Kantor Pelayanan Pajak (KPP) Pratama Saat ini KPP Pratama Majene membuka lowongan kerja untuk posisi Pramubakti untuk mendukung pelaksanaan tugas dan fungsi KPP Pratama. Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama Majene 1. Tenaga Keamanan/Security (KODE: SEC) KRITERIA PELAMAR WNI, diutamakan pria untuk kebutuhan pola dinas/piket malam Usia minimal 20 tahun dan maksimal 32 tahun per 1 Januari 2027 Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau sederajat Tinggi badan minimal 160 cm dengan berat badan proporsional Memiliki Sertifikat Pelatihan Satpam minimal Gada Pratama dan KTA aktif Sehat jasmani dan rohani, tidak bertato/tindik, tidak buta warna, dan bebas narkoba Disiplin, berintegritas tinggi, tegas, dan berorientasi pada pelayanan prima SIM A/C aktif menjadi nilai tambah BERKAS LAMARAN Pasfoto

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören die Abstimmung mit Fachplanenden, Nachunternehmenden und der Bauleitung, das Führen von Baubesprechungen sowie die Dokumentation des Baufortschritts. Sie erkennen frühzeitig Abweichungen, initiieren geeignete Maßnahmen und tragen so zu einem reibungslosen Bauablauf bei. Die Position ist eine Vollzeitstelle, wird vor Ort ausgeübt und ist in Berlin, Germany angesiedelt. Sie besitzen ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um mit Projektbeteiligten wie Auftraggebenden, Fachplanenden und ausführenden Unternehmen klar und lösungsorientiert zusammenzuarbeiten. Sie haben Erfahrung in der Qualitätskontrolle und sind in der Lage, Ausführungsqualität, Arbeitssicherheit und Einhaltung von Normen und Vorschriften systematisch zu überwachen. jobs.title: SEA Manager Google Ads (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Pflegia Pflegia ist Deutschlands führende Jobplattform für Fachkräfte im Gesundheitswesen. Unsere Mission: Bewerbungen im Gesundheitswesen so einfach, transparent und fair wie möglich zu machen. Mit der Unterstützung von Ardian, einer der weltweit führenden Investmentgesellschaften, skalieren wir unsere KI-gestützte Recruiting-Plattform, um das internationale Wachstum voranzutreiben und das Recruiting im Gesundheitswesen in ganz Europa zu verändern. Du wirst Teil unseres Performance Marketing Teams, berichtest direkt an unseren Lead of Performance Marketing und arbeitest eng mit unseren internen Teams aus IT, Design und Produkt zusammen. Deine Aufgaben Planung, Einrichtung und Optimierung unserer Google-Ads-Kampagnen, vor allem Search (sowie PMax): Budgets, Gebotsstrategien, Keywords, Zielgruppen und Anzeigentexte. Steuerung der Kampagnenstrategie: Definition der Kampagnenarchitektur, Identifikation von Seiten mit hoher Conversion-Rate, Festlegung klarer Wachstumsziele und Verantwortung für ein monatliches Google-Ads-Budget von mindestens 100.000 €. Volle Verantwortung für Landingpage-Konzepte, Tests und die kontinuierliche CRO-Optimierung (die Seiten werden von unserem IT-Team umgesetzt). Regelmäßiges Testen von Anzeigentexten, Gebotsstrategien und Landingpage-Elementen, um die Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Pflege unserer Dashboards (Looker Studio) und Weitergabe zentraler Erkenntnisse und datenbasierter Empfehlungen an das Team. Das bringst Du mit Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Google-Ads-Performance-Marketing, idealerweise im Bereich Lead Generation. Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Steuerung eines monatlichen Google-Ads-Budgets von mindestens 100.000 € (hauptsächlich Search). Fundiertes Verständnis von Landingpage-Optimierung, CRO und Conversion-Flows der Nutzer. Datengetriebene Denkweise mit starken analytischen Fähigkeiten und strukturierter Arbeitsweise. Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B1) und gute Englischkenntnisse. Von Vorteil Praktische

jobs.description: Hi, I’m Harriet, Ashby ’s VP Marketing. I joined Ashby in August 2022 to lead the Marketing function. My career journey has been anything but linear starting out as a yoga teacher, working as an M&A lawyer, before finding my happy place in marketing. This is a common theme across the team, and we love to see people who have built their skills both inside and outside the marketing discipline. Over the past ~4 years, we’ve gone from a stealth brand to the default operating system for over 5,000 of the most ambitious companies in tech, finance, and healthcare. On this journey, we’ve also amassed a marketing team of ~30 folks from across North America and Europe who are some of the brightest and most humble humans that want to ‘win’, and have fun doing so. Our culture is focused on creating a space to do lots of career-defining work with the tools, people, and focus that means minimal thrash and lots of autonomy. You can learn a little more about how we work here and why our investors are excited about us here . For this role, we are looking for someone to lead demand generation for our enterprise segment in Europe. You will have a fantastic thought partner and US counterpart, Ben , as well as the autonomy to rethink and define the strategy and execution to fit the nuances of the different European markets. It’s ABM but not in its traditional form: we’re seeking a first-principles thinker who prioritizes meaningful engagement over generic tactics / outdated playbooks (for example, prioritizing a few key impactful moments of engagement over running a laundry list of generic tactics across digital channels). If working with both the sales and marketing team to find and convert enterprise pipeline in a low ego, highly ambitious environment appeals, we’d love to hear from you! Prozesse dokumentieren

In this role, you'll work at the intersection of 3D reality and AI, transforming raw point cloud data into accurate digital twins of real-world production environments. From data preparation to model generation and delivery, you'll help ensure quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across our data pipeline. Your daily work Process 3D scan data (point clouds) and transform it into usable digital factory models using our internal tools and workflows. Run basic pipeline commands for data preparation and AI processing. Configure and verify model outputs to ensure quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications (e.g., Nvidia Omniverse, Siemens Plant Simulation and others). Collaborate with AI-assisted tools to validate and correct automated results. Flag and troubleshoot anomalies or edge cases in raw or processed data, and document issues clearly (e.g., as Git issues). Track and report your weekly processing output. jobs.title: Business Partner AXA Financial Indonesia KPM Bekasi
jobs.description: INGIN PUNYA KENDALI PENUH ATAS PENGHASILAN DAN WAKTU ANDA? Kami membuka kesempatan bagi Anda yang berjiwa wirausaha untuk bergabung sebagai Business Partner di bidang layanan pemasaran produk asuransi AXA Financial Indonesia. Lepaskan diri dari rutinitas kerja kantoran standar. Raih otonomi profesional sejati dengan dukungan penuh dari infrastruktur agensi kami yang mapan, mentor berpengalaman, dan sistem yang sudah teruji. BENEFIT Potensi penghasilan tanpa batas. Kendali penuh atas waktu serta jadwal harian Anda sendiri. Akses penuh ke dukungan persiapan sertifikasi/lisensi, pelatihan intensif 1-on-1, serta kerangka kerja yang teruji untuk membantu Anda mencapai profitabilitas dengan cepat. YANG AKAN ANDA LAKUKAN: Secara aktif membangun jejaring (networking), mencari prospek baru, dan menjalin hubungan konsultatif baik di komunitas lokal maupun digital. Melakukan sesi konsultasi mendalam untuk menganalisis dan mendiagnosis potensi risiko keuangan yang dihadapi klien. Menyusun dan mempresentasikan solusi proteksi (asuransi) serta mitigasi risiko yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan klien ritel maupun komersial. Menjaga dan membina hubungan baik dengan basis klien secara berkelanjutan demi meningkatkan pendapatan pasif (residual income) tahunan Anda. KANDIDAT IDEAL: Memiliki motivasi yang kuat untuk mencapai target (hunter mentality) serta kecerdasan emosional (EQ) yang tinggi. Berpengalaman di bidang yang berinteraksi langsung dengan klien, layanan pelanggan premium (high-end customer service), memiliki latar belakang kompetitif, atau berpengalaman sebagai mitra independen. Memandang penolakan bukan sebagai hambatan, melainkan sebagai bagian dari proses menuju "Ya" berikutnya. Memiliki komitmen penuh untuk belajar dan mengikuti sertifikasi/lisensi industri asuransi resmi (seluruh materi dan dukungan belajar akan disediakan).

jobs.description: About the role At Agile Robots, we build powerful software frameworks to orchestrate complex robotic systems and solve challenging tasks. The solutions are sold to various international customers to enable them to control their robotic work cells. Smooth integration and scalable deployment are key goals.  AgileCore is meant to be a scalable platform that supports multiple projects in parallel. That only works if the platform underneath scales with it - if it stays fast, thread-safe, and diagnosable as projects, devices, and operating conditions multiply. We are looking for a Senior C++ Performance Engineer to join our AgileCore Runtime core team. This is a T-shaped role in a small senior team: you are a full member of the core team first - contributing to the Runtime, reviewing contributions from the teams that build on our platform, and sharing our support and release duties - and within the team, you own the performance and stability practice as your specialization. On the specialization side, you will drive the performance of the Runtime core - the Blackboard, the Behavior Engine and the execution paths beneath them - make the system provably thread-safe under load, and make failures in the field fast to diagnose. You own the practice: the methodology, the tooling, the benchmarks, the audits and the education. You work hand in hand with the platform architect, who owns the performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts at the architecture level - you turn those budgets into measured, enforced reality and shape them with your findings. You set the standard for performance, concurrency and troubleshooting, and raise the team s ability to meet it without slowing feature development down. This is a shipping role, not a research role: success is measured in merged improvements, closed field escalations and green regression gates - not in microbenchmark leaderboards. Client application teams develop the business use cases; you lead AI platform delivery and the changes needed for teams to adopt and operate it. Berikut ini lowongan kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS). Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah. Aman Regulasi artinya bahwa pengelolaan zakat harus memperhatikan rambu-rambu peraturan hukum dan perundangan. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

For over 65 years, we ve delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. Your responsibilities will include: Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements. Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports. Analysing traffic, transport and movement data. Assisting with junction assessments and development impact studies. Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments. Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions. jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Bina BNI Kantor Wilayah 17. P T Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero), Tbk pada awalnya didirikan di Indonesia sebagai Bank sentral dengan nama “Bank Negara Indonesia” berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah Pengganti Undang-Undang No. 2 tahun 1946 tanggal 5 Juli 1946. Selanjutnya, berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 17 tahun 1968, BNI ditetapkan menjadi “Bank Negara Indonesia 1946”, dan statusnya menjadi Bank Umum Milik Negara. Selanjutnya, peran BNI sebagai Bank yang diberi mandat untuk memperbaiki ekonomi rakyat dan berpartisipasi dalam pembangunan nasional dikukuhkan oleh UU No. 17 tahun 1968 tentang Bank Negara Indonesia 1946. Berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah No. 19 tahun 1992, tanggal 29 April 1992, telah dilakukan penyesuaian bentuk hukum BNI menjadi Perusahaan Perseroan Terbatas (Persero). Penyesuaian bentuk hukum menjadi Persero, dinyatakan dalam Akta No. 131, tanggal 31 Juli 1992, dibuat di hadapan Muhani Salim, S.H., yang telah diumumkan dalam Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 73 tanggal 11 September 1992 Tambahan No. 1A. Bangunan aslinya dirancang oleh arsitek Ceko Antonin Raymond dan Ladislav Rado. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja Kedutaan Besar Amerika Serikat (AS) di Indonesia. Selanjutnya, berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 17 tahun 1968, BNI ditetapkan menjadi “Bank Negara Indonesia 1946”, dan statusnya menjadi Bank Umum Milik Negara. Selanjutnya, peran BNI sebagai Bank yang diberi mandat untuk memperbaiki ekonomi rakyat dan berpartisipasi dalam pembangunan nasional dikukuhkan oleh UU No. 17 tahun 1968 tentang Bank Negara Indonesia 1946. You'll work directly alongside global Account Managers, helping deliver merchandise programs for some of the biggest brands in the world. This is a coordination and client support role at its core, and a proven launchpad into a career in sales. Room to Grow Your Career The Sales Coordinator role is a strong foundation for building a career with the client. Coordinators who want to move toward Sales typically progress into an Associate Account Manager role, and from there, into other client-facing or leadership positions within Sales Operations. Progression depends on individual readiness, performance, and business needs, but there's a real, well-supported path for coordinators who want to grow.

Maintain and oversee the organization of financial records and supporting documentation, ensuring proper documentation, accessibility, retention, and compliance with established records management and audit requirements. Perform quarterly balance sheet account reconciliation activities across assigned entities, including analysis of account movements, identification of aged or unusual items, investigation of variances, and timely resolution or escalation of reconciling items. Perform end-to-end bookkeeping and accounting activities for assigned entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely recording of financial transactions and appropriate recognition of costs in accordance with accounting policies. Monitor and manage the vendor invoice lifecycle, including follow-up on outstanding invoices, resolution of invoice-related issues, coordination with vendors and internal stakeholders, and timely processing to support accurate period-end closing and payment.
